attribution.estimator: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4); estimates attribute visible prompt and tool traffic only. Provider input includes cached conversation, tool schema, and framework context.

gateNotes.navigationInputTokens: Evaluated on navigation-category paired runs only; null (not applicable) when a run has no navigation tasks. Task files without categories default to navigation, which preserves pre-v0.5.5 numbers.
gateNotes.expectedFileSourcePrecision: Benchmark proxy for context focus (expected-file unique source bytes / all unique source bytes). Not semantic correctness and not a gate.

determinism.note: Coefficient of variation across repetitions of the same task and condition. Describes run-to-run stability only; it is not a correctness measure.

firstRelevantDecomposition.note: firstRelevantMs is measured from agent process spawn to completion of the first tool call that read an expected file. It therefore includes agent startup, provider latency for every model turn before that call, and tool execution.

notes.providerDrift: Absolute provider input-token values across campaigns are not directly comparable: provider-side context (system prompt, tool schema, cached framework context) can change between campaigns even with an identical agent and model version. Only same-campaign paired reductions are valid performance evidence.
